notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.53 — Critical attendance reliability fix. The normal induction YES/NO checklist now includes ALL candidates booked onto that date on official MBL, including people whose call-board status is Spoke To, Call Back, No Answer or unconfirmed; no one is automatically recorded absent. Exact YES/NO decisions are preserved in local records before any network call, never silently overwritten by an old official status, and remain available when moving through Proceeding and Pipeline. Every official Attended / Not Attended update is verified by reading back the actual call stage; rejected or unverified updates remain flagged for review rather than being reported as synced. The Hub audits previously saved attendance history on refresh to detect missing official outcomes, shows urgent black/red warnings on Home and Pipeline and in Settings > Connection details, offers a reviewed one-click retry of the already-saved decision, and can copy an evidence-based correction report. Historical attendance screens also include provisionally booked candidates and protect previously recorded outcomes; original Proceeding decisions stay accessible. Existing candidate history, queued review for Abdul, and all local recruitment records remain untouched. Some official transitions may still require correction by authorised MBL administrators; the Hub will never fabricate attendance, silently force bookings, or bypass official stage restrictions. Windows release tests additionally verify the existing Home shortcuts remain unchanged.
